Comparator rows of Table 2 reproduce APOGEE 2 (Bianco et al. 2023, Nat Commun 14:5058) cross-validation results on a missense-only set (140 pathogenic, 1,734 neutral). They were not measured on this paper's test split and are not extracted; only the Evo2 row is recorded.

evidence_concerns.message: Comparator rows reproduce APOGEE 2 (Bianco et al. 2023) cross-validation results on a missense-only set (140 pathogenic, 1,734 neutral). They were not measured on this paper's test split, so Table 2 does not compare like with like. Separately, Table 2 sensitivity/specificity 0.867/0.825 (balanced accuracy 0.846) versus Figure 2B and text 90.2%/85.0% (87.6%); the source does not explain the difference.
